```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# add headlines
cat("\n\n#", gias_treated$ESTAB_NAME[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")

# print some information about the school
cat("Type of establishment:", gias_treated$typeofestablishment[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
cat("Phase:", gias_treated$phaseofeducation[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
cat("Gender of pupils:", gias_treated$gender[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
cat("Religious character:", gias_treated$religiouscharacter[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
cat("Local authority:", gias_treated$la[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")
cat("Region:", gias_treated$gor[gias_treated$URN == urn_school], "\n\n")


# download comparison data
url <- paste0("https://financial-benchmarking-and-insights-tool.education.gov.uk/school/", urn_school, "/comparison/download")
file_name <- file.path(dir_tmp, paste0(urn_school, ".zip"))
download.file(url, destfile = file_name, mode = "wb")
zip::unzip(file_name, exdir = dir_tmp)
invisible(file.remove(file_name))

# Benchmark spending: define comparator dfs
# 30 similar schools to benchmark this school against running cost categories, which includes all staffing (excluding premises staff), ICT, consultancy and catering.
df_comp_pupil <- read.csv(file = file.path(dir_tmp, paste0("comparison-", urn_school, "-pupil.csv")))

# extract comparator URNs after removing any treated schools
urn_comp <- df_comp_pupil %>%
  filter(! URN %in% urn_treated) %>%
  pull(URN)

# get AAR data for treated school
aar_school <- aar %>%
  filter(URN == urn_school)

# get AAR data for comparator schools
aar_comp <- aar %>%
  filter(URN %in% urn_comp)

# identify URNs of schools for regional average
gias_region <- gias %>%
  tidyr::replace_na(list(admissionspolicy = "unknown", boarders = "unknown")) %>% 
  filter(
    grepl("Open", establishmentstatus),
    ! URN %in% urn_treated,
    phaseofeducation %in% unique(c(gias_treated$phaseofeducation[gias_treated$URN == urn_school])),
    gor %in% c(gias_treated$gor[gias_treated$URN == urn_school]),
    ! parliamentaryconstituency %in% unique(c(gias_treated$parliamentaryconstituency[gias_treated$URN == urn_school])),
    ! grepl("Boarding school", boarders),
    admissionspolicy != "Selective"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

# extract comparator URNs in same region
urn_region <- gias_region %>%
  pull(URN)

# get AAR data for regional average across phase type
aar_region <- aar %>%
  filter(URN %in% urn_region)

# combine data
df <- bind_rows(aar_school %>%
                  mutate(group = "Treated"), 
                aar_comp %>%
                  mutate(group = "Comparator set average")) %>%
  bind_rows(., aar_region %>%
              mutate(group = "Regional phase average"))

# actuals #
cat("\n\n## Actuals\n\n")

# aggregate data
df_agg <- df %>%
  group_by(time_period, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(
      matches("^(cost_|income|expend)"),
      ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(time_period_str = insert_slash(time_period))

for (ii in 1:length(vars)) {
  # plot timeseries for each variable
  plt <- ggplot(data = df_agg, aes(x = time_period, y = get(vars[ii]), col = group, group = group)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    ambition_theme +
    ylab("Actuals") + xlab("Academic year") +
    ggtitle(paste0(urn_school, ": ", vars[ii])) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_currency(prefix = "£", scale_cut = scales::cut_long_scale())) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = df_agg$time_period, labels = df_agg$time_period_str) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Treated" = red,
                                  "Regional phase average" = blue,
                                  "Comparator set average" = navy)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.title = element_blank())
  print(plt)
  cat("\n\nNote.",vars[ii], "=", meta$description[meta$column_name == vars[ii]], "\n\n")
  rm(plt)
  gc()
}

# percentage income #
cat("\n\n## Percentage of income\n\n")

# aggregate data
df_agg <- df %>%
  group_by(time_period, group) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(
      matches("^(cost_staff|income|expend)"),
      ~ mean(.x/income_tot, na.rm = TRUE)
    ), .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(time_period_str = insert_slash(time_period))

for (ii in 1:length(vars)) {
  
  if(grepl("income", vars[ii])) next
  
  # determine axis limits
  if (vars[ii] %in% vars[grepl("tot_teach|teaching", vars) & !grepl("tot_teachsupp", vars)]) {
    limit = c(0.4, 0.9)
  } else if (grepl("income|expend", vars[ii])) {
    limit = c(0.75, 1.25)
  } else {
    limit = c(0, 0.5)
  }

  # plot timeseries for each variable
  plt <- ggplot(data = df_agg, aes(x = time_period, y = get(vars[ii]), col = group, group = group)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    ambition_theme +
    ylab("% of income") + xlab("Academic year") +
    ggtitle(paste0(urn_school, ": ", vars[ii])) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = df_agg$time_period, labels = df_agg$time_period_str) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), limits = limit, breaks = seq(0, 2, 0.1)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Treated" = red,
                                  "Regional phase average" = blue,
                                  "Comparator set average" = navy)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          legend.title = element_blank())
  print(plt)
  cat("\n\nNote.",vars[ii], "=", meta$description[meta$column_name == vars[ii]], "\n\n")
  rm(plt)
  gc()
}
```
